resources.string: No lock screen. While CarPlay is connected, the status bar, notification shade, Home and Recents are hidden. Hold the power button for the power menu.
DiPlay turns the tablet\'s Wi-Fi off by itself and can pin CarPlay. Turn off to give device owner back.
Give device owner back? DiPlay will stop turning Wi-Fi off by itself and stop pinning CarPlay. Setting it up again needs adb.
Installing the update. DiPlay restarts when it\'s done.
